name: John Vincent Heffernan

events.title: Marriage
events.description: Married Edith Corrine Grammes (NYC marriage index as "Edith C. Graham")

bioAdditions: FamilySearch gives the marriage as 4 May 1914 in Manhattan and his wife as Edith Corrine Grammes (1896-1938), daughter of Cyrus Randolph Gramm(es) and Martha L. Robinson; she died at Wilkes-Barre on 6 Nov 1938 and is buried at Fairview Cemetery, Danville. Their daughter was Mary Louise Heffernan (1921-2011) (S1, S2).

conflicts.foundValue: Grammes (Find a Grave index; parents Gramm/Grammes); "Graham" in the NYC marriage index
conflicts.assessment: Grammes looks correct; "Graham" is probably an index anglicisation.
